create_singleton_db: create a MephistoSingletonDB instance with an optional database path for in-memory caching of all data model objects
shutdown_db_connections: shutdown the MephistoSingletonDB by closing the current thread's database connection and removing it from the connection pool
cache_load_result: cache a loaded data model object in the singleton cache by its class type and db_id for fast subsequent lookups
optimized_load_cached: optimized_load a cached data model object by class and db_id from the singleton cache without hitting disk
find_units_by_assignment: find all units for a given assignment_id using the cached assignment-to-unit mapping for fast lookup
